custom_logic_notes: EA uses Zig-Zag indicator to confirm swing structure and filter entries based on Bollinger Band touches. The two MAs provide trend direction filter. Long entries require price near lower band with MA crossover confirmation and Zig-Zag swing low formation. Short entries require price near upper band with MA crossunder and Zig-Zag swing high. Digit adjustment applied to SL/TP (multiply by 10 for 5-digit brokers).
python_conversion_notes: Zig-Zag indicator must be reimplemented in Python as it has no direct equivalent in common Python TA libraries. The Zig-Zag is used as a confirmation filter, not the primary signal, so a simplified swing-detection algorithm may suffice. Bollinger Bands and MAs are available in ta-lib or pandas-ta. Digit adjustment logic (multiplying SL/TP by 10 for 5-digit brokers) must be preserved. Entry signals use previous bar values ([1]) for crossover detection - ensure shift is handled correctly in Python. The new-bar guard pattern (tracking bar time to prevent multiple signals per bar) needs explicit implementation in Python.
